items.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
items.summary: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks and the suspected gunman has been apprehended.

items.title: Seven shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
items.summary: Thirty-four people are also injured in the attack in southern Karak governorate, and a manhunt is now under way.

items.title: Freed US citizen was tortured in Russian jail, former Ukrainian prisoners say
items.summary: Ukrainians held alongside the American say they witnessed beatings and sexual humiliation by Russian guards during his detention.

items.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
items.summary: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.

items.title: White House says Melania Trump brokered truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
items.summary: Ukraine and Russia confirm the truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents have had to eat garden weeds to survive.

items.title: Argentina drops investigation into President Milei over crypto fraud
items.summary: Javier Milei had denied acting fraudulently when a cryptocurrency nosedived after he deleted a social media post about it.
